{"reason": "All 20 failure rows are false arbitrations with confidence below 0.7 (0.44–0.67, e.g. pct=-0.428, exposure=1300000, confidence=0.66). Adding the high-confidence? gate should cut false-arbitration-rate from 0.714 while retaining confident positives, protecting the recall>=0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
